svg.title: deadreckon menubar template glyph (filled / live)
svg.desc: Optional exactness asset (SETTINGS-SCREENS-SPEC.md §I2). The same 45° diamond as the app icon's mark: miter points, half-diagonal 7, centered at (8,8). Template rendering: black shape, alpha-only — macOS tints it. This file is the FILLED variant (live/attention states). The IDLE variant is the identical path with fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5" (points then inset to half-diagonal 6.25 so the stroke stays inside the canvas). v1 ships SF Symbols diamond/diamond.fill instead; export this to a template PDF only if pixel-true kinship with the app icon is wanted.
